William Pawelec worked in computer security and access-control technology. In this interview, he discussed his professional experiences and raised concerns about the relationship between emerging technologies, secrecy, and power.

According to those who recorded the interview, Pawelec requested that it remain unpublished until after his death. He died in 2007, and permission to release the recording was granted in December 2010.

DISCLAIMER
The interview includes personal recollections and allegations that have not been independently verified. This video is presented for documentary and informational purposes.
